description: This file contains engine math functions, engine load calculations, fuel schedule management, ignition timing, and engine control setup for the rusEfi project.

classes.name: FuelSchedule
classes.description: Class managing fuel injection events, including scheduling and initialization.

methods.name: getEngineCycleDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of an engine cycle based on RPM and operation mode.

methods.name: getCrankshaftRevolutionTimeMs
methods.description: Returns milliseconds per crankshaft revolution based on RPM.

methods.name: getEngineLoadT
methods.description: Returns engine load according to the selected engine load mode.

methods.name: setSingleCoilDwell
methods.description: Configures dwell times for single coil ignition systems.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Calculates spark dwell time based on RPM and engine configuration.

methods.name: getCrankingSparkDwell
methods.description: Returns dwell time during engine cranking.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Returns spark dwell time, considering cranking or running state.

methods.name: getFiringOrderLength
methods.description: Returns the number of cylinders in firing order based on configuration.

methods.name: getCylinderId
methods.description: Maps index to cylinder ID based on firing order.

methods.name: getIgnitionPinForIndex
methods.description: Determines ignition pin index for a given cylinder index.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionPinIndices
methods.description: Prepares ignition pin indices based on ignition mode.

methods.name: getCurrentIgnitionMode
methods.description: Returns current ignition mode, considering spin-up conditions.

methods.name: prepareOutputSignals
methods.description: Initializes engine output signals and trigger shape during configuration changes.

methods.name: setFuelRpmBin
methods.description: Sets RPM bins for fuel table scaling.

methods.name: setFuelLoadBin
methods.description: Sets load bins for fuel table scaling.

methods.name: setTimingRpmBin
methods.description: Sets RPM bins for ignition timing table scaling.

methods.name: setTimingLoadBin
methods.description: Sets load bins for ignition timing table scaling.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Configures fuel algorithm and ignition table scaling.
